title: Pseudomorph - Synthetic Data Generator & Evaluator
summary: A command-line and GUI Python application that generates and evaluates synthetic tabular data from real datasets, offering statistical distribution comparison, correlation analysis, PCA visualization, and privacy assessment. It directly wraps SDV's single-table API, importing GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, and SingleTableMetadata to perform the actual data generation.
evidence: generator.py:41-48 imports GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, and SingleTableMetadata from sdv.single_table/sdv.metadata
